headline: 33 Hemi-network/token addresses catalogued from docs and token list; no address for the Hemi Stake (veHEMI) contracts was found.

findings.text: Direct fetches of the app website and explorer.hemi.xyz failed. A search surfaced one explorer page (0x2D9F04E3…) for which only a stub snippet was returned, so it is not catalogued. No name-tag search results were obtained for Hemi Stake.

The docs Contract Addresses page lists 21 Ethereum L1 core contracts (OP-stack style: portal, bridges, dispute game, ProxyAdmin, SystemOwnerSafe, etc.), 5 Hemi L2 predeploys and BitcoinKit v1. It lists no staking, veHEMI or reward contracts. The docs Stake page also lists no addresses.

No audit_links were pinned. The docs Stake page links no audits. The veHEMI README mentions audit findings (HIGH-2, a 2026-05-04 audit) and has an audits/ folder, but the report was not opened, so no scope addresses were extracted.

The hemilabs/veHEMI repo (VeHemi, VeHemiVoteDelegation, VeHemiAragonAdapter, VeHemiStorageV2) has a deployments/hemi directory, which I could not open because the fetch budget ran out. The token-list repo gave the HEMI token on Hemi plus its OFT adapter.

The protocol is Hemi-only (chainId 43111). Addresses for Ethereum L1 infrastructure and the HEMI token on Ethereum/Hemi are recorded as separate per-chain entries. Staking-contract addresses on Hemi were not surfaced.
No factory was identified. The veHEMI README references a PositionFactory (src/utils), but no address was found, so no children were enumerated.
Roles were assigned from the docs' contract names. Only SystemOwnerSafe is tentatively labelled a multisig, going by its name. Bytecode was not read, so most actor_class values are unknown.

Every address in admin_addresses traces to the docs Contract Addresses page or the token-list file, both fetched in this run. The explorer stub (0x2D9F04E3…) and addresses seen only in search snippets are excluded.

rationale.verdict: Discovery slice: grade is always unknown. I walked the Hemi docs addresses page, the docs Stake page, the token list and the veHEMI README, and catalogued 33 network and token addresses. No Hemi Stake contract address was recovered.

evidence.shows: Official Hemi docs address page. It lists Ethereum L1 core contracts (AddressManager, ProxyAdmin, SystemOwnerSafe, OptimismPortalProxy, L1StandardBridgeProxy, etc.), L2 predeploys and BitcoinKit v1. It contains no staking contracts.
Docs index. It links Contract Addresses, Stake and How to Stake, Token Contract Details, and a Support and Bug Reports page for security disclosure. It has no dedicated staking-address page.
Docs Stake page: describes Hemi Stake as a reward-deposit model with no slashing and no lock-up, and lists supported assets. It lists no contract addresses.

Hemi token list (chainId 43111). HEMI token is 0x99e3dE3817F6081B2568208337ef83295b7f591D with an Ethereum bridge token 0xEb964A1A6fAB73b8c72A0D15c7337fA4804F484d and an OFT adapter 0xf14A494Fb66927Df0b1495E5F09b410e5D8517C3. It also lists hemiBTC and many other tokens.

veHEMI repo README. It describes the VeHemi, VeHemiVoteDelegation, VeHemiAragonAdapter and VeHemiStorageV2 contracts. VeHemi is a time-locked HEMI voting escrow with NFT locks, a forfeit admin and Aragon TokenVoting integration. Upgrades go through proxies via a Gnosis Safe MultiSend. A deployments/hemi directory and an audits directory exist.
Search-result body. The Hemi Stake UI reads VeHemi (VeHemi.increaseAmount at veHEMI commit c6a65c74154377e8720f584b364bdc109fbdedc5), which ties the current Hemi Stake product to the veHEMI repo.
Search-result body. The 'Ship Hemi stake' PR replaces /staking-dashboard with /hemi-stake. It also says boost staking is a different product with different contracts.

unknowns: D1-offchain: fetch of https://app.hemi.xyz/en/stake/dashboard/ failed (could not be accessed). Fetch of https://explorer.hemi.xyz/address/0x2D9F04E30222503AE7B401E876C3b69D3252BfcD failed. No on-chain read was possible this run.

D1: The Hemi explorer (explorer.hemi.xyz) name-tag search for 'Hemi Stake', 'veHEMI' or 'VeHemi' was not performed. Search grounding returned only a stub snippet for one explorer address (0x2D9F04E30222503AE7B401E876C3b69D3252BfcD), role unverified.

D2: The docs list no veHEMI/VeHemi proxy, VeHemiVoteDelegation, VeHemiAragonAdapter, forfeit admin, owner Safe or reward-contract addresses. The Stake docs page describes older multi-asset reward contracts without addresses. Whether 'Hemi Staking' here means veHEMI or the older multi-asset staking is unresolved.
D3: The veHEMI audits/ folder and the audit PDFs were not opened (fetch budget exhausted). No audit scope addresses or firm names were obtained. No audit_links were pinned.

D4: https://github.com/hemilabs/veHEMI/tree/main/deployments/hemi (hardhat-deploy artifacts with proxy addresses) was not fetched because the tool-call limit was hit. No commit SHA was pinned for the veHEMI repo. The next run should fetch deployments/hemi/*.json.

D5: chain Hemi: zero staking-contract addresses surfaced from the website (fetch failed), docs Contract Addresses, docs Stake page, token-list and veHEMI README. Hemi-chain addresses recorded are only the predeploys, the HEMI token, the OFT adapter and BitcoinKit.
D6: PositionFactory (src/utils/PositionFactory.sol in veHEMI) is mentioned in the README coverage list, but no deployed factory address was found. No children were enumerated.

D7: Bytecode was not read for any address, so owner/Safe status is unconfirmed. SystemOwnerSafe is labelled a multisig from its name only. The ProxyAdmin owner and the Hemi L2 predeploy admin are unknown.

D8: The Hemi chain (chainId 43111) is not in the DeFiPunkd supported chainIds, so no surfacer or read-API call can be made for Hemi addresses. Ethereum L1 addresses could be surfaced with chainId 1 in a later run. 0x2D9F04E30222503AE7B401E876C3b69D3252BfcD was seen only as a stub search snippet and is excluded from admin_addresses.

D3: bug bounty and security contact not verified. The docs 'Support and Bug Reports' page (docs.hemi.xyz/feedback/contact) was listed in llms.txt but not fetched. The veHEMI repo shows a Security policy tab, content unread.
D2: governance_forum and voting_token not verified. The veHEMI README says veHEMI is the Aragon TokenVoting voting token via an adapter, but no adapter address or forum URL was fetched.

protocol_metadata.about: Hemi Stake lets users lock HEMI tokens to earn rewards and governance weight. The veHEMI README describes a voting-escrow design: each lock is an NFT with up to a 4-year duration, and voting power and incentive share decay linearly. Voting power can be delegated and is exposed to Aragon TokenVoting through an adapter. The older docs page describes a reward-deposit model for BTC, ETH and stablecoin assets with no lock-up.
